subject: planner: fix new index join build forget to convert cop to root when prop require rootTaskType (#61275)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent; only runtime change is in `pkg/planner/core/index_join_path.go` where `getBestIndexJoinInnerTaskByProp` now returns a RootTask via `ConvertToRootTask` when `prop.TaskTp` is `property.RootTaskType`. This aligns the returned task type with the required physical property and preserves `IndexJoinInfo` during conversion (via `CopTask.ConvertToRootTask`), avoiding mismatched-task behavior in index-join build v2. Remaining changes are test/golden updates plus a new integration coverage case. No Blocker/High issues found in planner/executor behavior. Checked later history on `upstream/master`; the area was later heavily refactored (including eventual removal of index join build v1), with no indication this specific fix was reverted due to correctness issues.
